QUOTE: When the second `llama_tokenize` returns a negative value (line 64), `LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` logs an error containing only the text length and returns `{}`, an empty vector.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a negative second-call result leads to an error log and an empty return, and it says outright that the failure path does not retry at all.
